hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"PLANNING GATE: Before entering plan mode, ensure you have multi-model advisory context. If you have NOT yet consulted Codex architect_review or Gemini gemini_brainstorm in this session for the current task, call them NOW (they work in plan mode since plan mode supports all tools except Write/Edit). COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '^\s*git\s+(push|commit)'; then TRANSCRIPT=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && grep -q 'code_review' "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"PUSH GATE: You are about to git push/commit but Codex code_review has NOT been run in this session. Per multi-model workflow, you MUST run Codex code_review and Gemini gemini_review_pr on the diff before pushing. If the user explicitly said skip review, proceed. Otherwise, STOP and run both reviews first."}}'; fi; else exit 0; fi
